title: 第16章 两女得逞，态度
novel_title: 听我解释，真不是你们想的那样！
content_zh:
柔光照亮了散落的月白色薄衫。

    她像一朵终于盛放的花。

    “呜呜呜，师弟，你怎么能这样呢！以你的词条，师姐，师姐这是还要……！”

    姜怀玉在嘤嘤哭泣，但陆沉确是充耳不闻，甚至他还冷笑一声。

    “你给我整东西了对不对？不然我怎么会失去自我理智？”

    看着被自己失手打成伤痕累累的姜怀玉，陆沉只觉得彻骨的冰冷。

    为什么？！为什么事情会发展到这种地步？？

    明明就差一步，他们就可以见面了，无论结果怎么样，至少他为此努力了！

    可为什么……

    “师弟你可不能胡说呀！师姐，师姐只是想要和你道歉，然后你就……打人！呜呜呜！”

    姜怀玉继续飙升演技。

    陆沉：“……”

    他有些不太想搭理这个戏精，但事已至此，他也不知道该怎么办了，眼中只剩下纯粹的迷茫。

    看着陆沉不说话，看向自己时眼里都是芥蒂和冷漠，姜怀玉也终于收了演技，不哭了。

    “陆沉，你觉得我是什么？”她忽然问。

    “你当然是我师姐……”

    “我是说，在他那里。”

    “他想和离就和离，想回头就回头。他高兴了，把我捧在手心，不高兴了，就把我扔出去。那我呢？我的感受算什么？我还是一个修士吗？”

    陆沉张了张嘴，无言以对。

    “他父母知道真相之后，看我的眼神像看脏东西。现在想孙女了，又让我回去。那我算什么？他们王家的工具人吗？”

    “我不是物件，不是他想要就要、想丢就丢的东西！我是一个人！一个拥有自己尊严的人！”
content_en:
The soft light illuminated the scattered moon-white thin shirts.

She is like a flower that finally blooms.

"Uuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuu Junior brother, how could you do this! With your words, senior sister, senior sister, this is what you want...!"

Jiang Huaiyu was crying, but Lu Chen turned a deaf ear and even sneered.

"You fixed things for me, right? Otherwise, how could I lose my mind?"

Looking at Jiang Huaiyu, who was badly bruised by his own mistake, Lu Chen felt cold to the bone.

Why?!Why did things develop to this point??

It was obviously just one step away from them meeting each other. No matter what the outcome was, at least he had worked hard for it!

But why...

"Junior brother, you can't talk nonsense! Senior sister, senior sister just wants to apologize to you, and then you... hit people! Wuwuwu!"

Jiang Huaiyu continues to soar in acting skills.

Lu Chen: "..."

He didn't want to deal with this drama queen, but now that it was over, he didn't know what to do, and there was only pure confusion in his eyes.

Seeing that Lu Chen was silent and looked at him with resentment and indifference in his eyes, Jiang Huaiyu finally put aside his acting skills and stopped crying.

"Lu Chen, what do you think I am?" she asked suddenly.

"Of course you are my senior sister..."

"I mean, at his place."

"He made peace when he wanted to, and turned back when he wanted to. When he was happy, he held me in his hands, and when he was unhappy, he threw me out. What about me? What do my feelings mean? Am I still a monk?"

Lu Chen opened his mouth, speechless.

"After his parents knew the truth, they looked at me as if they were dirty. Now they miss their granddaughter and asked me to go back. So who am I? A tool of their Wang family?"

"I'm not an object, something he can take or throw away whenever he wants! I'm a person! A person with his own dignity!"
title_en: Chapter 16 Two women succeeded, their attitudes
